description: This file implements the AddressTrackerLinux class, which manages network interface addresses and link states on Linux systems using netlink sockets. It handles address updates, interface status changes, and connection type determination, primarily for network monitoring within Chromium.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux
classes.description: Manages network interface addresses and link states on Linux, handling address updates, interface status changes, and connection type detection.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux::AddressTrackerAutoLock
classes.description: Helper class for managing lock acquisition and release within AddressTrackerLinux.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves the interface name for a given interface index.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux::Init
methods.description: Initializes the netlink socket and starts address and link state monitoring.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux::DumpInitialAddressesAndWatch
methods.description: Requests initial address and link state dumps and sets up socket watching.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux::ReadMessages
methods.description: Reads and processes netlink messages from the socket.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux::HandleMessage
methods.description: Handles individual netlink messages, updating address and link state data.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux::OnFileCanReadWithoutBlocking
methods.description: Callback invoked when socket is readable to process incoming messages.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux::UpdateCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Determines current network connection type based on interface states.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux::SetDiffCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked with address and link state diffs.
